name: frida-mlbb

scripts.wait-and-hook: while [ -z $(adb shell ps -A | grep ':UnityKillsMe' | awk '{print $2}') ]; do sleep 1; done; PID=$(adb shell ps -A | grep ':UnityKillsMe' | awk '{print $2}'); echo 'PID Found: ' $PID; frida -U -p $PID -l dist/agent.js

description: MLBB All-In-One JSON Scraper & Live Telemetry Agent (Stealth Mode)
